title: JavaScript: Loops
description: Write a JavaScript program using for loops, while loops, and for-of iteration.
verificationTest: output.includes('For loop:') && output.includes('1 2 3 4 5') && output.includes('While loop:') && output.includes('5 4 3 2 1') && output.includes('Sum 1 to 10: 55')
hints: Use `for (init; condition; increment)` for counter-based loops
Use `while (condition)` when the number of iterations is unknown
Use `for...of` to iterate over array elements
